headlines.title: House Democrats select Jeffries as leader, setting him up as the first Black speaker
headlines.description: Rep. Hakeem Jeffries of New York won his party’s nomination for speaker of the House, putting him on a glide path for election to the top job on the first day of the new Congress in January.

headlines.title: Trump to hold one-on-one with Putin on the sidelines of Asia summit
headlines.description: President Donald Trump will hold a one-on-one meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin on Thursday, a U.S. official confirmed, marking the leaders’ first in-person meeting in over a year.

headlines.title: House Democrat warns a dozen Trump allies to save their records, calling it ‘just the beginning’
headlines.description: Democratic Rep. Robert Garcia, who will chair the House Oversight Committee, sent 12 letters to associates of President Donald Trump to save their records ahead of investigations.

headlines.title: DHS secretary ‘98% confident’ tech outages not caused by US adversaries
headlines.description: Top national security officials from the Trump administration faced questions on Capitol Hill about recent, widespread technology failures across U.S. industries. NBC News’ Sahil Kapur and Jared Perlo report on what these incidents mean for future cybersecurity efforts.

headlines.title: Shut out of meeting, Zelenskyy says what he would say to Trump, Xi and Putin
headlines.description: Ahead of Trump's meeting with Presidents Putin and Xi, Zelenskyy speaks exclusively with NBC News' Richard Engel. Zelenskyy talks about what he would advocate for if he were present at the meeting and why he thinks sanctions against Russia are crucial to ending the war.

headlines.title: Jeffries says House Democrats will 'fight for an affordable America'
headlines.description: Rep. Hakeem Jeffries, D-N.Y., delivered remarks after being voted as his party's nominee to serve as the next speaker of the House. Jeffries discussed how he will "fight for an affordable America" and that "the status quo is unacceptable."

headlines.title: How the White House Correspondents’ Association dinner chaos unfolded
headlines.description: Secret Service faced challenges evacuating President, Vice President, Cabinet officials and Congressional leaders after gunman rushes D.C. gala.

headlines.title: Xi greets Trump as he arrives in China, a rare move ahead of Putin talks
headlines.description: In a rare and surprising move, Chinese leader Xi Jinping personally greeted President Donald Trump as he arrived in China on Wednesday ahead of historic three-way talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

headlines.title: Amid string of outages, bipartisan letter urges strategy to combat AI-assisted cyber threats
headlines.description: In the midst of a series of recent cyber outages, there is growing concern by members of Congress that the Trump administration needs to do more to protect infrastructure from cyberattacks that are aided by AI, according to a new bipartisan letter sent by two senators to the White House’s AI czar.

headlines.title: Democrat Mary Peltola flips Alaska Senate seat, defeating GOP Sen. Dan Sullivan
headlines.description: Democrat Mary Peltola defeated Republican Sen.

headlines.title: White House drops Heidi Overton’s FDA nomination after Republicans raise concerns
headlines.description: The White House is dropping Dr. Heidi Overton’s nomination to lead the Food and Drug Administration, a White House official confirmed Tuesday.

headlines.title: Sean Duffy’s $50B demand for air travel fixes is met with yelling and skepticism in Congress
headlines.description: The Trump administration’s request for $50.1 billion in new FAA funding after a nationwide ground stop is running into skepticism from both parties in Congress.
